sources.location: PRIDE PXD043452 txt.7z: txt/parameters.txt and txt/mqpar.xml (MaxQuant 1.5.3.30; run list = the 20 RAW files)

claims.value: 10 Thermo .raw files from the af1521 arm of PXD043452
claims.evidence: All 10 af1521 RAW entries carry projectAccessions PXD043452; WT and MD1 each have suffixes 01-05.

claims.location: characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[organism] rows 1-10
claims.evidence: Methods names 293T cells. Cell line lookup resolves the exact synonym 293T to HEK293T, CVCL_0063, Homo sapiens.

claims.location: source name, comment[technical replicate], characteristics[biological replicate], factor value[PARP14 construct], factor value[affinity capture] rows 1-10
claims.value: WT or MD1 mutant PARP14; af1521 bead arm; technical culture replicates 1-5 per construct | Source name is one per construct (293T-PARP14-MD1, 293T-PARP14-WT); the five culture replicates are technical replicates 1-5 of that source, as the paper calls them "technical" replicates.
claims.evidence: Methods state that each lysate was split between Af1521-linked and empty control beads. This companion SDRF contains one bead arm; the source names are identical across paired companion files and the technical replicate column preserves the five culture replicate indices encoded by filename suffixes 01-05. Biological replicate 1 is a coordinate placeholder, not an assertion of separately enumerated biological samples.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[cleavage agent details] rows 1-10
claims.evidence: Methods describe Orbitrap Exploris 480, top-13 precursor selection with HCD, and on-bead trypsin digestion.

claims.location: comment[ms min charge], comment[ms max charge] rows 1-10
claims.evidence: MS methods specify selection of precursor charge states 2 to 6.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[modification parameters] rows 1-10
claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M and Acetyl protein N-term variable; precursor 4.5 ppm; fragment 20 ppm
claims.evidence: parameters.txt: Fixed modifications Carbamidomethyl (C); MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm. mqpar.xml: variable modifications Oxidation (M), Acetyl (Protein N-term); mainSearchTol 4.5, searchTolInPpm true; enzyme Trypsin/P, maxMissedCleavages 2. PRIDE: default settings except LFQ.
Cellosaurus CVCL_0063 (HEK293T) has no disease (DI) line; the cell-lines template says to use normal for non-disease-derived cell lines.

limitations: This artifact contains only one bead arm; its companion SDRF contains the paired arm. Together they cover all 20 RAW files.
Pairing across arms by equal filename index is inferred from the stated lysate split and matched naming, not independently documented by a sample manifest.
The search used the Trypsin/P rule with up to 2 missed cleavages; the cleavage agent column records the wet-lab enzyme, trypsin.
